$summary: Focus-ring geometry. Always used together with theme.focus-ring.

focus.summary: Focus-ring geometry. Always used together with theme.focus-ring.
use: outline-width and outline-offset in a :focus-visible rule.
dont: Removing the ring or shrinking it below these values.
Setting the offset to 0 on a filled accent control — the gap is what separates the ring from the accent fill behind it.

scale.ring-width: The outline thickness, thick enough to see at a glance.
scale.ring-offset: The gap between the element and the ring, which keeps the ring legible against a filled background.

example.css: :focus-visible { outline: var(--rata-focus-ring-width) solid var(--rata-theme-focus-ring); outline-offset: var(--rata-focus-ring-offset); }
